message.reasoning:
Giving p3 the yellow monopoly feels risky since they already hold Atlantic and Marvin Gardens, but with only 13 houses left and my own cash at $61, they'd likely be too cash-poor to build aggressively right away.

I could mortgage Reading, both railroads, Oriental, Vermont, North Carolina, and Ventnor to free up over $600 if needed, so I'm not actually desperate for liquidity. A better counter might be trading Ventnor for Pacific Avenue plus some cash instead — since I already hold North Carolina and Pennsylvania, getting Pacific would complete the green monopoly for me, making this a fairer monopoly-for-monopoly swap rather than just handing them yellow outright.
